text: Bat-Guy beat every villain in the city. Except one. The electricity bill. The bat signal runs all night. Every night. For twenty years. The bill came in. Four point two million dollars. He sold the car. He sold the cape. He sold the butler. Then he did the only thing left: robbed a bank. Who caught him? Nobody. The city couldn't afford the signal anymore. What's your worst bill? Be honest.
